title: GitHub Actions security
description: Checks for build workflow permissions, action pinning and deployment credentials.

rules.instruction: Give each GitHub Actions job the permissions needed for its task. Keep privileged operations and credentials outside jobs that run untrusted changes.
rules.verification: Compare the effective permissions of changed jobs with their steps. Verify that the proposed pull request workflow can run its checks without write access or deployment credentials.

rules.instruction: Pin external action references in changed workflows to reviewed full commit SHAs, and record the corresponding upstream versions.
rules.verification: Confirm that each pinned commit belongs to the intended upstream repository and matches the reviewed release or commit.

rules.instruction: Use short-lived deployment credentials when the provider supports them. Restrict the identity to the approved repository, workflow or environment context and the required cloud permissions.
rules.verification: Check the trust-policy conditions against the approved workflow claims and review the cloud role's permissions for the intended deployment.

rules.instruction: Declare `permissions:` in every workflow, so jobs get the permissions their steps need and not the default.
rules.verification: task verify evaluates the check on the working tree; review each file it names.

rules.instruction: Do not grant `write-all` in a workflow or a job: list the scopes the steps need, with read access where nothing is written.
rules.verification: task verify evaluates the check on the working tree; review each file it names.
